Features

Everything you need, nothing you don't

A fully modular media platform — enable only the features you need. Every module can be toggled on or off independently.

Unified Media Manager

Manage TV series and movies from one interface. Automated search, grab, and organization with quality profiles and intelligent upgrading.

Flexible Download Engines

Use the built-in torrent and usenet clients, or bring your own — qBittorrent, Transmission, SABnzbd, NZBGet, and more are fully supported.

Smart Search

9-specification decision engine ranks releases across multiple indexers. Newznab, Torznab, and Prowlarr-compatible Cardigann definitions supported.

Media Streaming

Built-in video streaming with HLS transcoding and direct play. Replaces Plex with native library browsing, watchlist sync, and activity monitoring.

Automated Scheduling

Background tasks for RSS sync, library import scanning, metadata refresh, and Plex integration run automatically on configurable schedules.

Import & Rename Engine

Disk scanner detects new media, parses release names, matches to metadata, and renames/organizes files according to your naming format.

Built Different

Rust-powered from top to bottom

NGMS is written entirely in Rust with a React TypeScript frontend. No Python scripts, no Java runtime, no Node backend — just a single compiled binary backed by PostgreSQL.

The modular crate architecture means each component is independently testable, and the async Tokio runtime handles thousands of concurrent operations without breaking a sweat.

Why switch to NGMS?

See how NGMS stacks up against the traditional *arr suite.

Capability Sonarr + Radarr + Prowlarr NGMS
Containers required 3 separate containers 1 single container
TV + Movie management 2 separate apps ✓ Unified
Indexer management Separate app (Prowlarr) ✓ Built-in
Download clients External only ✓ Built-in + BYO
Media streaming Requires Plex/Jellyfin ✓ Built-in HLS + Direct Play
Database SQLite (lock contention) PostgreSQL
Language / Runtime C# / .NET Rust (native binary)
Memory footprint ~500MB+ (3 apps) ~80MB single process
Modular features × All or nothing ✓ Enable/disable per module
First-boot wizard Per-app setup ✓ Zero-config

Up and running in 60 seconds

Choose Docker Compose or a single container — NGMS handles the rest.

docker-compose.yml 
services:
  ngms:
    image: ghcr.io/ausagentsmith-org/stackarr
    ports:
      - "9111:9111"
    volumes:
      - ./config:/config
      - /media:/media
    environment:
      - STACKARR_DATABASE_URL=postgres://...
    restart: unless-stopped
Terminal 
# Quick start with Docker
docker run -d \
  --name ngms \
  -p 9111:9111 \
  -v ./config:/config \
  -v /media:/media \
  ghcr.io/ausagentsmith-org/stackarr

# Open the web UI
open http://localhost:9111

First boot launches a guided setup wizard. See the full documentation for advanced configuration.
